reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:34-41 the cron first deletes every EMAIL reminder with scheduledDate <= now regardless of the cancelled flag, and only afterwards (lines 44-74) looks up cancelled reminders to send the SendGrid cancel. Because emailReminderManager.ts now only sets cancelled=true instead of cancelling immediately, a cancelled reminder whose scheduledDate has passed before the cron reaches it is deleted with no cancel request ever sent.
